title: Implement FT-001 session lifecycle services
verify: Login creates a new LocalSession and does not revive expired or revoked sessions.
Session issuance uses the TASK-006 primitive: raw token returned once through transport, only SHA-256 token_hash persisted, and default expires_at is created_at plus 7 days.
Presented session tokens are verified by computing token_hash and using the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison path.
Logout revokes only the current session and invalid/missing logout can be idempotent.
Session validity is fail-closed from session, Account, and FarmMembership status.
Session services authenticate only active Account/FarmMembership records created by the separate admin/bootstrap boundary.
T3 closure includes /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, and explicit owner closure; /mb-sync runs at the wave boundary.

commands: compileall plus source-hygiene, scope, and forbidden-pattern scans
verify.summary: Functional verification passed. Existing active identities authenticate through the TASK-006 password primitive; issuance creates a new digest-only session with an exact seven-day TTL; validation uses token-hash lookup and the TASK-006 constant-time comparison path; malformed, unknown, revoked, expired, disabled, or ambiguous identity states fail closed; logout revokes only the presented session; and production services create or activate no Account/FarmMembership. Focused tests passed with 6 tests, the full suite with 47 tests, and dependency/Memory Bank/diff/scope/boundary checks passed.

commands: hostile timing probe comparing missing-login and existing-login wrong-password paths
hostile direct-issuance probe with caller-constructed AuthenticatedIdentity
verify.summary: Semantic verification found two unresolved T3 trust-boundary concerns: missing login skips Argon2 verification and creates a stable Account-enumeration timing signal, while publicly constructible AuthenticatedIdentity can be passed directly to issue_session without credential verification. No HTTP route currently exposes these paths, so the result is semantic-concern rather than semantic-fail. Repair TASK-007 in place, repeat /verify and /red-verify, and do not promote dependents before semantic-pass.

commands: deterministic credential-work parity probe for missing and existing login failures
hostile timing probe for missing and existing login failures
verify.summary: Repeated semantic verification confirms the public issuance bypass is repaired, but missing login still skips Argon2 verification. A deterministic probe observed only one verifier call across missing-login and existing-login mismatch branches, and timing remained approximately 0.001 ms versus 59.6 ms. The linked no-account-enumeration behavior is therefore not substantively satisfied. Complete dummy verification repair, repeat /verify, and repeat /red-verify before closure or dependent promotion.

commands: public session-issuance surface and failed-auth persistence checks
verify.summary: Post-repair functional verification passed. Public session creation now goes through SessionService.login, failed authentication creates no session rows, and digest-only issuance, exact TTL, fail-closed validation, revocation, scope, Foundation, and anti-goal checks remain satisfied. Focused tests passed 6/6 and the full suite 47/47. The explicit owner separately accepts timing-based enumeration risk for this task.
verify.recommended_next_action: repeat /red-verify using the explicit owner risk decision, then record T3 human checkpoint and closure

verify.owner_decision: The user explicitly accepts timing-based login enumeration as residual local-MVP risk and excludes it from this task's closure threat model.
verify.summary: Semantic verification passes under the explicit owner threat-model decision. The public issuance bypass is repaired, post-repair functional gates pass, and lifecycle/storage/fail-closed boundaries fit the intended task. Timing enumeration remains measurable and is explicitly accepted rather than represented as fixed.
verify.recommended_next_action: record HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done and explicit owner closure; defer /mb-sync to W2 boundary

verify.owner_decision: The user explicitly instructed the top-level agent to close TASK-007 as completed and accepted the documented timing-enumeration residual risk.
verify.summary: TASK-007 is closed after current post-repair functional PASS, owner-approved semantic-pass with accepted residual timing risk, and the required human checkpoint.
verify.recommended_next_action: continue W2 with a separate readiness decision for TASK-008; run /mb-sync at the W2 boundary

evidence_required: session issuance evidence showing 7-day expires_at and token_hash-only persistence
session verification evidence showing malformed/unknown/revoked/expired tokens fail closed through token_hash lookup
evidence that session services do not create or activate Accounts/Memberships
constraints: Default session TTL is 7 days from created_at.
Do not silently revive expired or revoked sessions; login creates a new LocalSession.
Session services must consume the TASK-006 credential/session primitive and must not reimplement password hashing, token generation, token_hash derivation, or digest comparison with divergent rules.
Session services authenticate existing active identities and must not create or activate Account/FarmMembership records.

Preserve verified FT-000 app factory, settings, database/session, migration, readiness, runtime-root, and redaction anchors per Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, and Evidence Redaction specs; stop if implementation contradicts the brownfield baseline.
invariants: Missing, expired, revoked, malformed, or unknown session fails closed.
Disabled Account or disabled FarmMembership fails closed.
Secrets/auth material must not enter logs, timeline, manifests, Bus, UI Feed, screenshots, exports, or agent context.
verification_targets: Check changed code preserves linked Foundation Runtime Substrate, Foundation Data Substrate, Foundation Smoke API when relevant, and Evidence Redaction contracts or records a blocker.
Check session lifecycle tests prove created_at plus 7-day expires_at calculation, current-session-only logout revocation, and no revival of expired/revoked sessions.
Check session verification tests use token_hash lookup and the TASK-006 constant-time digest comparison primitive for valid, malformed, unknown, revoked, and expired tokens.
Check session repositories/services use the Foundation Data Substrate session boundary and preserve the FT-001 session lifecycle.
purpose: Implement the FT-001 local password-session lifecycle for existing active Accounts and FarmMemberships.
success_outcome: Local credentials and sessions can be issued, validated, revoked, and fail-closed against Account and FarmMembership status.
anti_goals: No Account creation or bootstrap flow.
No hosted recovery or email delivery.

forbidden_scope: FT-003 Account creation or first-Boss bootstrap
stop_conditions: Session lifecycle cannot be proven fail-closed.
Session service reimplements or diverges from the TASK-006 credential/session primitive contract.
Implementation requires creating or activating Account/FarmMembership records inside session services.
Raw auth material would enter persistence, logs, or evidence.
Implementation contradicts verified FT-000 app/settings/database/session/redaction baseline.
